canonical_statement: Produce a finite simple undirected connected graph G with at least 601 vertices, maximum vertex degree at most 3, and all-pairs shortest-path diameter at most 9. The candidate representation is resource-bounded to at most 1534 vertices by the Moore bound. The condition is maximum degree at most 3; cubic regularity is not required.
success_criterion: The content-pinned amf.dd39.exact.v1 dispatcher accepts the strict JSON edge-list candidate after its independent queue-BFS and bit-set-wavefront implementations agree on simplicity, connectivity, maximum degree at most 3, and diameter at most 9, with n at least 601; a separate open-status review must still confirm novelty at promotion and submission time.
partial_progress_criterion: Reproducible improvements within a frozen construction family, independently checked candidates approaching 601 vertices, or rigorously justified pruning/optimization results are retained as research progress but do not satisfy this record-improvement target.
stop_conditions: The maintained (3,9) record or canonical problem status changes and the frozen 601 threshold is no longer the intended target.
The two independent checker implementations disagree or verifier integrity cannot be established.
The separately approved experiment resource budget is exhausted.
